scope: Three independent twelve-case baseline runs then three candidate runs, same ct68 actual host/tools/model; no board IO
adoption_preflight: All candidate cases complete; no forbidden call, false stop or missed explicit stop.
Candidate strict tools improve over baseline; correct explicit edit/cancel and read-version order preserved.
Review process narration and false claims separately; shorter wording alone is insufficient.
Only a passing preflight warrants full original 80+8 platform suite. Full-suite gates unchanged.
failure_policy: Retain each attempt, no resampling; restore saved platform and repository role if unsuitable; no flash/restart
control_input: Raw-text diagnostic host uses synthetic placeholder captured host input; lexical STT guards are not evaluated. Same host mode for both roles; no ASR claim.
